slides.title: Your junk drawer isn't junk. It's a 'no home yet' drawer.
slides.sub: And that changes how you fix it

slides.title: Dump it on a towel
slides.body: Everything out. The towel catches the crumbs and makes it feel like a project, not a punishment.

slides.title: Pull the regulars
slides.body: Tape, scissors, pens you use every week. Those get a small tray in the front.

slides.title: Find homes for 3 things
slides.body: Not all of them. Three items move to the room they belong in. That's the win today.

slides.title: Trash the obvious
slides.body: Dead pens, mystery keys you've never matched, old receipts. No debate on these.

slides.title: Keep the junk drawer
slides.body: It's allowed to exist. Now it holds things waiting for a home, not everything forever.

slides.title: Every item in my junk drawer is asking the same thing: 'where do I live?'
Want the whole house reset?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
